entity_1_name: Nodes: Small Kernel Size Limitation<==>Limitation on Small Kernel Sizes

The constraint that some sparse convolution methods are not applicable to small kernel sizes (e.g., 3x3), which are commonly used in modern CNN architectures, thus limiting their applicability and potential for speedup.
entity_2_name: The restriction of some sparse convolution methods to large filter sizes (e.g., 9x9), which limits their applicability to modern CNN architectures that often utilize smaller filters (e.g., 3x3). This constraint hinders the ability of these methods to fully exploit the potential of sparse convolution in current CNN designs.
